answer.report_md:
## 画出来要什么
一张窄栏折线图，嵌在正文左栏，右侧是与之并排的正文段落（`Significant amounts of EU savers' money are either tied up in bank accounts or invested abroad.`）。图内需要：三条年度折线（蓝、绿、黄，2011–2023 共约 13 个点），但图例只画出两项 `EU`、`US`，绿线（按正文应为 UK）没有名字；图例置于绘图区内部约 y=20 处；左轴 `0`–`100`、每 10 一格、无网格线，单位 `%` 单独写在顶格 `100` 右侧；x 轴刻度斜排且只标奇数年 `2011 … 2023`；下方两段小字 `Note:` 与 `Source: European Commission, DG FISMA`；标题 `Figure 4:` 与标题句在图上方。

## 定位一个值难在哪
以 EU 的 43 为例：图上没有任何数值标签，只能对着 10 单位一格的刻度读线；而 EU 线在 45→43 之间几乎水平，43 与 45 相差仅 4.4%，小于 5% 容差，等于说相邻年份互相可以冒充。再者 2022 这类偶数年根本没有刻度标签，行标签只能靠推。

## 不确定的
绿线的名称（正文提到 UK 55%，图上无字）；十个给定值对应的具体年份是我按“末点=43/72”倒推的；是否存在极淡的横向网格线看不清。

heading.title: Household savings invested in bonds, shares, investment funds and similar.

worked_example.why_hard: EU line nearly flat 45 to 43; 10-unit ticks, no labels, no gridlines, adjacent years within tolerance

components.evidence: `EU` and `US` swatches drawn over the plot area at about the 20 level
`Note: Volumes of household savings in company bonds...` and `Source: European Commission, DG FISMA` below plot
Body paragraph `Significant amounts of EU savers' money...` runs in a column level with the figure
`%` is the only unit text, printed next to the top tick `100`
`100 %` -- the percent sign sits beside the top tick, above the axis
`2011`, `2013` ... `2023` set at roughly 45 degrees under the plot
lines bend yearly but ticks are only odd years 2011, 2013 ... 2023
superscript `94`, `95`, `96` attached to sentences naming Figure 4 and KPI 15

new_components.evidence: figure, Note and Source occupy the left half-column; body text fills the right half

the yellow US line at the same early point
the blue EU line, next year (about 2020), indistinguishable from the previous

answer.hardest_step_why: 无数值标签，刻度每10；EU 43 与 45 只差4.4%，低于5%容差，且2020、2022无刻度，年份行标签也难对上。

examples.quote: three lines are drawn (blue, green, yellow) but the legend shows only `EU` and `US`
examples.why: 第三条线只能靠颜色和正文的 UK 55% 命名，生成器无法产出“图例缺项”的序列。

examples.quote: `Figure 4:` and `Household savings invested in bonds, shares, investment funds and similar.` above; `%` only at the top tick
examples.why: 编号、标题与单位分处三个位置，单位不在标题里而在轴顶，需标题分字段。

examples.quote: x ticks `2011 2013 2015 2017 2019 2021 2023` slanted, yearly line points between them; y ticks every 10
examples.why: 刻度稀疏加斜排、单位置于轴顶，这类刻度格式与单位位置目前不可控。

examples.quote: figure, `Note:` and `Source: European Commission, DG FISMA` fill the left column; body text runs beside it
examples.why: 整页导出需知道图与并排正文、注释源行的相对位置，现无页级 markdown。
